title: The Open Source AI Definition – version 1.0 (Open Source Initiative)
key_points: OSI 定义：Open Source AI 是「以授予四项自由的方式提供的 AI 系统」——(1) 为任何目的使用而无需请求许可；(2) 研究其运作方式并检查其组件；(3) 为任何目的修改，包括改变其输出；(4) 为任何目的分享（含或不含修改）。

OSI 明确：这些要求对 system、model、weights and parameters 或其他结构元素一视同仁——「To be considered Open Source, the requirements are the same, whether applied to a system, a model, weights and parameters, or other structural elements.」
行使上述自由的前提是能获得「修改该系统的首选形式（preferred form to make modifications）」。
对机器学习系统，preferred form 必须包含三类要素：Data Information（训练数据的足够详细信息，使有技能者可构建实质等同系统）、Code（训练与运行系统的完整源代码）、Parameters（模型参数如权重或配置）。
Data Information 须披露：全部训练数据的完整描述（含不可共享数据）、数据来源与范围特征、获取与筛选方式、标注流程、数据处理与过滤方法；并列出所有公开可得的训练数据及其获取位置。
Code 须采用 OSI 认可的许可证；Parameters 须以 OSI 认可条款提供。

OSI 对术语的定义：An AI model consists of the model architecture, model parameters (including weights) and inference code for running the model；AI weights are the set of learned parameters that overlay the model architecture to produce an output from a given input。
raw_excerpt: An Open Source AI is an AI system made available under terms and in a way that grant the freedoms to: Use the system for any purpose and without having to ask for permission. Study how the system works and inspect its components. Modify the system for any purpose, including to change its output. Share the system for others to use with or without modifications, for any purpose. ... To be considered Open Source, the requirements are the same, whether applied to a system, a model, weights and parameters, or other structural elements. ... The preferred form of making modifications to a machine-learning system must include all the elements below: Data Information ... Code ... Parameters ... AI weights are the set of learned parameters that overlay the model architecture to produce an output from a given input.

title: LLAMA 3.1 COMMUNITY LICENSE AGREEMENT (meta-llama/llama-models)
key_points: Llama 3.1 采用「Community License Agreement」，而非标准开源许可证；许可授予的是「non-exclusive, worldwide, non-transferable and royalty-free limited license」——即有限、非独占、不可转让的许可。
再分发条件：分发 Llama Materials 或其衍生作品时，须随附本协议副本，并在相关网站/界面/博客/产品文档显著展示「Built with Llama」。
若用 Llama Materials 或其输出创建、训练、微调或改进 AI 模型并对外分发，须在该 AI 模型名称开头包含「Llama」。
商用规模限制（Additional Commercial Terms）：若在 Llama 3.1 发布日，被许可方或其关联方产品/服务的月活用户超过 7 亿（700 million monthly active users），须向 Meta 申请许可，且「Meta may grant to you in its sole discretion」——即 Meta 有单方面裁量权。
使用须遵守随附的 Acceptable Use Policy（使用政策），该政策通过引用并入协议——即存在使用目的限制。
协议将 Llama Materials 描述为「Meta's proprietary Llama 3.1 and Documentation」——即 Meta 自称为专有（proprietary）材料。

If, on the Llama 3.1 version release date, the monthly active users of the products or services made available by or for Licensee ... is greater than 700 million monthly active users in the preceding calendar month, you must request a license from Meta, which Meta may grant to you in its sole discretion ... "Llama Materials" means, collectively, Meta's proprietary Llama 3.1 and Documentation.

title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
key_points: DeepSeek-V3 是 MoE 语言模型，总参数 671B，每个 token 激活 37B 参数。
采用 Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) 与 DeepSeekMoE 架构。
预训练使用 14.8 万亿（14.8T）tokens。
训练全程仅需 2.788M H800 GPU 小时。
采用无辅助损失的负载均衡策略（auxiliary-loss-free）与多 token 预测（multi-token prediction）训练目标。
模型 checkpoint 发布于 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3。
raw_excerpt: We present DeepSeek-V3, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters with 37B activated for each token. ... We pre-train DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8 trillion diverse and high-quality tokens ... requires only 2.788M H800 GPU hours for its full training.

title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
key_points: DeepSeek-R1 通过纯强化学习（RL）激励 LLM 的推理能力，无需人工标注的推理轨迹。
RL 框架使模型涌现出自我反思、验证、动态策略调整等推理模式。
在数学、编程竞赛、STEM 等可验证任务上，其表现超过用传统监督学习（人类示范）训练的同类模型。
大规模模型涌现的推理模式可被系统性地用于指导并增强小模型的推理能力。
raw_excerpt: Here we show that the reasoning abilities of LLMs can be incentivized through pure reinforcement learning (RL), obviating the need for human-labeled reasoning trajectories. ... the trained model achieves superior performance on verifiable tasks such as mathematics, coding competitions, and STEM fields, surpassing its counterparts trained via conventional supervised learning on human demonstrations.

title: Qwen3 Technical Report
key_points: Qwen3 系列同时包含 dense 与 Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) 架构，参数规模从 0.6B 到 235B。
Qwen3 将 thinking 模式（复杂多步推理）与 non-thinking 模式（快速上下文响应）整合进统一框架，支持按查询或 chat template 动态切换。
引入 thinking budget 机制，允许在推理时自适应分配计算资源。
相比前代 Qwen2.5，多语言支持从 29 种扩展到 119 种语言和方言。
所有 Qwen3 模型以 Apache 2.0 许可公开发布。
raw_excerpt: The Qwen3 series includes models of both dense and Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) architectures, with parameter scales ranging from 0.6 to 235 billion. ... Compared to its predecessor Qwen2.5, Qwen3 expands multilingual support from 29 to 119 languages and dialects ... all Qwen3 models are publicly accessible under Apache 2.0.

title: Qwen2.5-1M Technical Report
key_points: Qwen2.5-1M 系列将上下文长度扩展到 100 万（1M）tokens，相比此前 128K 版本显著增强长上下文能力。
开源模型包括 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M 与 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M；另有 API 访问的 Qwen2.5-Turbo。
采用长度外推方法，可在无需额外训练的情况下将上下文长度扩展至少 4 倍。
在 1M tokens 上下文场景下实现 3x 到 7x 的 prefill 加速。
Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M 在长上下文任务上显著优于 GPT-4o-mini，并支持 8 倍长的上下文。
raw_excerpt: We introduce Qwen2.5-1M, a series of models that extend the context length to 1 million tokens. ... The Qwen2.5-1M series currently includes the open-source models Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M, as well as the API-accessed model Qwen2.5-Turbo. ... the Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M model significantly outperforms GPT-4o-mini in long-context tasks and supports contexts eight times longer.

title: Gemma 3 Technical Report
key_points: Gemma 3 是 Gemma 系列的多模态新增版本，参数规模从 1B 到 27B。
引入视觉理解能力、更广的语言覆盖，以及至少 128K tokens 的更长上下文。
通过提高局部注意力层相对全局注意力层的比例、并保持局部注意力跨度较短，来降低长上下文下易膨胀的 KV-cache 内存。
Gemma 3 模型使用蒸馏（distillation）训练。
raw_excerpt: We introduce Gemma 3, a multimodal addition to the Gemma family of lightweight open models, ranging in scale from 1 to 27 billion parameters. This version introduces vision understanding abilities, a wider coverage of languages and longer context - at least 128K tokens. We also change the architecture of the model to reduce the KV-cache memory that tends to explode with long context.

title: Phi-4 Technical Report
key_points: phi-4 是 14B 参数的语言模型，训练配方以数据质量为核心。
与多数以网页/代码等有机数据为主的模型不同，phi-4 在训练全程策略性地引入合成数据。
phi-4 在 STEM 类问答能力上大幅超越其教师模型（GPT-4），表明其数据生成与后训练技术超越了单纯蒸馏。
phi-4 相对 phi-3 架构改动极小，性能提升主要来自改进的数据、训练课程与后训练方案创新。
raw_excerpt: We present phi-4, a 14-billion parameter language model developed with a training recipe that is centrally focused on data quality. ... phi-4 substantially surpasses its teacher model on STEM-focused QA capabilities ... Despite minimal changes to the phi-3 architecture, phi-4 achieves strong performance relative to its size -- especially on reasoning-focused benchmarks.

title: 2 OLMo 2 Furious
key_points: OLMo 2 是新一代完全开放（fully open）语言模型，包含 7B、13B、32B 三个 dense 自回归模型规模。
完全释放的产物包括：模型权重、完整训练数据、训练代码与配方、训练日志以及数千个中间 checkpoint。
预训练数据混合引入新的专用数据配比 Dolmino Mix 1124，通过晚期课程训练（预训练退火阶段引入专用数据）显著提升下游基准表现。
OLMo 2-Instruct 借鉴 Tülu 3 最佳实践，聚焦宽松许可（permissive）数据，并将最终阶段强化学习扩展为可验证奖励的 RL（RLVR）。
OLMo 2 base 模型处于性能-训练算力帕累托前沿，常匹配或超越 Llama 3.1、Qwen 2.5、Gemma 2 等仅开放权重模型，且使用更少 FLOPs。
raw_excerpt: OLMo 2 includes a family of dense autoregressive language models at 7B, 13B and 32B scales with fully released artifacts -- model weights, full training data, training code and recipes, training logs and thousands of intermediate checkpoints. ... Our OLMo 2 base models sit at the Pareto frontier of performance to training compute, often matching or outperforming open-weight only models like Llama 3.1, Qwen 2.5, and Gemma 2 while using fewer FLOPs.

title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
key_points: DeepSeek-V3 是 MoE 语言模型，总参数 671B，每 token 激活 37B。
采用 Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) 与 DeepSeekMoE 架构以实现高效推理与低成本训练。
提出无辅助损失的负载均衡策略（auxiliary-loss-free load balancing）与多 token 预测（multi-token prediction）训练目标。
预训练语料为 14.8 万亿 token，随后进行 SFT 与 RL 阶段。
完整训练仅需 2.788M H800 GPU 小时，训练过程稳定，全程未出现不可恢复的 loss spike 或回滚。
评估显示其性能超过其他开源模型，并可与领先闭源模型相当。
raw_excerpt: We present DeepSeek-V3, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters with 37B activated for each token... DeepSeek-V3 adopts Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architectures... pioneers an auxiliary-loss-free strategy for load balancing and sets a multi-token prediction training objective... pre-train DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8 trillion diverse and high-quality tokens... requires only 2.788M H800 GPU hours for its full training.

title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
key_points: 论文主张 LLM 的推理能力可通过纯强化学习（pure RL）激发，无需人工标注的推理轨迹。
该 RL 框架使模型涌现出自我反思、验证、动态策略调整等高级推理模式。
在数学、编程竞赛、STEM 等可验证任务上，其表现超过用传统人类示范监督学习训练的同类模型。
大模型涌现的推理模式可被系统性地用于指导并增强小模型的推理能力。
raw_excerpt: Here we show that the reasoning abilities of LLMs can be incentivized through pure reinforcement learning (RL), obviating the need for human-labeled reasoning trajectories... facilitates the emergent development of advanced reasoning patterns, such as self-reflection, verification, and dynamic strategy adaptation... the emergent reasoning patterns exhibited by these large-scale models can be systematically harnessed to guide and enhance the reasoning capabilities of smaller models.

title: Qwen3 Technical Report
key_points: Qwen3 系列同时包含 dense 与 MoE 架构，参数规模从 0.6B 到 235B。
关键创新是把 thinking 模式（复杂多步推理）与 non-thinking 模式（快速上下文响应）整合进统一框架，可基于用户查询或 chat template 动态切换。
引入 thinking budget 机制，允许在推理时自适应分配计算资源以平衡延迟与性能。
利用旗舰模型的知识显著降低构建小规模模型所需的计算资源。
相比 Qwen2.5，多语言支持从 29 种扩展到 119 种语言和方言。
所有 Qwen3 模型以 Apache 2.0 许可公开。
raw_excerpt: The Qwen3 series includes models of both dense and Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) architectures, with parameter scales ranging from 0.6 to 235 billion. A key innovation in Qwen3 is the integration of thinking mode... and non-thinking mode... into a unified framework... Qwen3 introduces a thinking budget mechanism... all Qwen3 models are publicly accessible under Apache 2.0.

title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence
key_points: Kimi K2 是 MoE 大模型，激活参数 32B，总参数 1 万亿。
提出 MuonClip 优化器，在 Muon 基础上引入 QK-clip 技术以解决训练不稳定问题。
基于 MuonClip 在 15.5 万亿 token 上预训练，全程零 loss spike。
后训练包含大规模 agentic 数据合成流水线与联合 RL 阶段，模型通过与真实及合成环境交互提升能力。
在非思考设置下取得开源非思考模型 SOTA，Tau2-Bench 66.1、ACEBench(En) 76.5、SWE-Bench Verified 65.8、SWE-Bench Multilingual 47.3。
编码/数学/推理成绩：LiveCodeBench v6 53.7、AIME 2025 49.5、GPQA-Diamond 75.1、OJBench 27.1（均无扩展思考）。
raw_excerpt: We introduce Kimi K2, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language model with 32 billion activated parameters and 1 trillion total parameters. We propose the MuonClip optimizer... K2 was pre-trained on 15.5 trillion tokens with zero loss spike... K2 obtains 66.1 on Tau2-Bench, 76.5 on ACEBench (En), 65.8 on SWE-Bench Verified, and 47.3 on SWE-Bench Multilingual... 53.7 on LiveCodeBench v6, 49.5 on AIME 2025, 75.1 on GPQA-Diamond, and 27.1 on OJBench, all without extended thinking.

title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale
key_points: 论文指出 SOTA 推理模型（如 OpenAI o1、DeepSeek R1）的关键技术细节被隐藏，社区难以复现其 RL 训练结果。
提出 Decoupled Clip and Dynamic sAmpling Policy Optimization (DAPO) 算法。
完全开源了一个大规模 RL 系统，使用 Qwen2.5-32B 基座模型在 AIME 2024 上达到 50 分。
公开了四项关键技术细节，并开源训练代码（基于 verl 框架）与经整理处理的数据集，以增强可复现性。
raw_excerpt: key technical details of state-of-the-art reasoning LLMs are concealed (such as in OpenAI o1 blog and DeepSeek R1 technical report), thus the community still struggles to reproduce their RL training results. We propose the Decoupled Clip and Dynamic sAmpling Policy Optimization (DAPO) algorithm, and fully open-source a state-of-the-art large-scale RL system that achieves 50 points on AIME 2024 using Qwen2.5-32B base model... we open-source our training code, which is built on the verl framework, along with a carefully curated and processed dataset.

title: Economies of Open Intelligence: Tracing Power & Participation in the Model Ecosystem (arXiv:2512.03073v1)
key_points: 该研究基于 Hugging Face Model Hub 的完整周度下载历史数据集（2020年6月–2025年8月）与模型元数据，覆盖 851,000 个模型、每模型 200+ 聚合属性、22 亿次下载。
研究记录到开源权重生态经济权力的「根本性再平衡」：Google、Meta、OpenAI 所代表的美国开源权重产业主导地位大幅下降，让位于无隶属开发者、社区组织，以及截至 2025 年的中国产业。
DeepSeek 与 Qwen 模型可能预示着市场权力的新一轮集中（new consolidation of market power）。
模型属性出现统计显著变化：平均模型规模增长 17 倍，多模态生成增长 3.4 倍，量化（quantization）增长 5 倍，混合专家（MoE）架构增长 7 倍。
数据透明度出现令人担忧的下降：2025 年「开放权重（open weights）」模型首次超过「真正开源（truly open source）」模型。
生态中涌现出一层新的开发者中介（developer intermediaries），专注于对基础模型进行量化与适配，服务于效率与艺术表达两类目的。
论文附带交互式仪表盘用于实时监测开源模型经济的集中度动态（huggingface.co/spaces/economies-open-ai/open-model-evolution）。
raw_excerpt: We document a fundamental rebalancing of economic power: US open-weight industry dominance by Google, Meta, and OpenAI has declined sharply in favor of unaffiliated developers, community organizations, and, as of 2025, Chinese industry, with DeepSeek and Qwen models potentially heralding a new consolidation of market power. We identify statistically significant shifts in model properties, a 17X increase in average model size, rapid growth in multimodal generation (3.4X), quantization (5X), and mixture-of-experts architectures (7X), alongside concerning declines in data transparency, with open weights models surpassing truly open source models for the first time in 2025.

title: Economies of Open Intelligence (HTML full text, Section 1 Introduction)
key_points: Hugging Face Model Hub 目前托管 200 万+ 模型，累计独立下载量 17 亿次（论文自注：其使用的下载度量比 Hub 页面原始计数更精确）。
该 Hub 自 2019 年分发 BERT 与 GPT-2 的开放 PyTorch 格式起步，已演变为全球共享开放权重 AI 模型的首要平台。
论文作者机构包括 MIT、Data Provenance Initiative、ScaDS.AI Leipzig、University of Edinburgh、USC、UNC at Chapel Hill 以及 Hugging Face（Irene Solaiman、Avijit Ghosh、Yacine Jernite、Lucie-Aimée Kaffee）。
论文定位为首次系统性追踪开源模型生态中经济权力如何随时间集中与扩散的研究，并指出此前工作未系统考察该问题。
raw_excerpt: The Hugging Face Model Hub provides a unique window into these dynamics. What began as a mode of distributing the open PyTorch formats of BERT and GPT-2 models in 2019 has evolved into the primary global platform for sharing open weight AI models, now hosting 2M+ models with 1.7B unique, cumulative downloads.

title: Mistral Small 3 (official blog)
key_points: Mistral Small 3 是 24B 参数模型，以 Apache 2.0 许可发布。
同时发布预训练（base）与指令微调（instruct）两个 checkpoint，均为 Apache 2.0。
官方称其在 MMLU 上超过 81% 准确率，延迟约 150 tokens/s。
官方称该模型未使用 RL 或合成数据训练。
官方称其性能与 Llama 3.3 70B instruct 相当，且在同硬件上快 3 倍以上。

title: Mistral Small 3.1 (official blog)

title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
key_points: DeepSeek-V3 是一个 MoE 语言模型，总参数 671B，每个 token 激活 37B 参数。
该模型采用 DeepSeekMoE 架构（细粒度专家）与 Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) 以实现高效推理与低成本训练。
DeepSeek-V3 首创（pioneers）无辅助损失（auxiliary-loss-free）的负载均衡策略。
训练目标中加入 multi-token prediction 以提升性能。
预训练使用 14.8 万亿（14.8 trillion）tokens。
完整训练仅需 2.788M H800 GPU 小时，训练过程稳定，全程未出现不可恢复的 loss spike 或回滚。
论文声称其性能超过其他开源模型，并与领先闭源模型相当（属作者自述主张）。
模型权重发布于 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3。
raw_excerpt: We present DeepSeek-V3, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters with 37B activated for each token. ... DeepSeek-V3 adopts Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architectures ... Furthermore, DeepSeek-V3 pioneers an auxiliary-loss-free strategy for load balancing and sets a multi-token prediction training objective ... We pre-train DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8 trillion diverse and high-quality tokens ... requires only 2.788M H800 GPU hours for its full training.

title: Qwen2.5-1M Technical Report
key_points: Qwen2.5-1M 将上下文长度扩展到 100 万 token，相比此前 128K 版本通过长上下文预训练与后训练显著增强长上下文能力。
采用的关键技术包括长数据合成（long data synthesis）、渐进式预训练（progressive pre-training）与多阶段监督微调（multi-stage SFT），以在降低训练成本的同时提升长上下文性能。
开源了推理框架，包含一种长度外推方法，可在无需额外训练的情况下将模型上下文长度扩展至少 4 倍甚至更多。
为降低推理成本，实现了稀疏注意力（sparse attention）方法、chunked prefill 优化，以及用于提升精度的 sparsity refinement 方法。
借助该推理框架，Qwen2.5-1M 在 100 万 token 上下文场景下实现 3x 到 7x 的 prefill 加速。
开源模型包括 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M 与 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M；Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M 在长上下文任务上显著优于 GPT-4o-mini，并支持 8 倍长的上下文。
raw_excerpt: We introduce Qwen2.5-1M, a series of models that extend the context length to 1 million tokens... Key techniques such as long data synthesis, progressive pre-training, and multi-stage supervised fine-tuning are employed... This framework includes a length extrapolation method that can expand the model context lengths by at least four times, or even more, without additional training. To reduce inference costs, we implement a sparse attention method along with chunked prefill optimization... Qwen2.5-1M models achieve a remarkable 3x to 7x prefill speedup in scenarios with 1 million tokens of context.

title: NoLiMa: Long-Context Evaluation Beyond Literal Matching
key_points: NoLiMa 是一个扩展 NIAH（needle-in-a-haystack）的长上下文评测基准，其 needle 集合设计使问题与 needle 之间词面重叠极小，要求模型推断潜在关联来定位 needle。
论文评测了 13 个声称支持至少 128K token 上下文的流行 LLM。
这些模型在短上下文（<1K）表现良好，但随着上下文长度增加性能显著下降；在 32K 时，13 个模型中有 11 个跌破其短长度强基线的 50%。
GPT-4o 从近乎完美的 99.3% 基线下降到 69.7%。
分析认为性能下降源于注意力机制在缺少字面匹配的长上下文中更难检索相关信息；即便加入推理能力或 CoT 提示，模型也难以在长上下文中维持性能。
数据集与评测代码开源于 https://github.com/adobe-research/NoLiMa。
raw_excerpt: We evaluate 13 popular LLMs that claim to support contexts of at least 128K tokens. While they perform well in short contexts (<1K), performance degrades significantly as context length increases. At 32K, for instance, 11 models drop below 50% of their strong short-length baselines. Even GPT-4o... experiences a reduction from an almost-perfect baseline of 99.3% to 69.7%.

title: SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs
key_points: 论文提出 SGLang，一个用于高效执行复杂语言模型程序的系统，由前端语言和运行时组成。
运行时通过 RadixAttention 实现 KV cache 复用，以及压缩有限状态机实现更快的结构化输出解码。
实验显示 SGLang 在多种大语言与多模态模型上，相比当时最先进的推理系统实现最高 6.4x 的吞吐提升。
评测任务涵盖 agent control、逻辑推理、few-shot 学习基准、JSON 解码、RAG 流水线和多轮对话。
论文作者包括 Lianmin Zheng、Ying Sheng、Ion Stoica、Joseph E. Gonzalez 等，代码发布于 github.com/sgl-project/sglang。
raw_excerpt: The runtime accelerates execution with novel optimizations like RadixAttention for KV cache reuse and compressed finite state machines for faster structured output decoding. Experiments show that SGLang achieves up to 6.4x higher throughput compared to state-of-the-art inference systems

title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
key_points: 论文提出 PagedAttention，一种受操作系统虚拟内存与分页技术启发的注意力算法。
在 PagedAttention 之上构建了 vLLM，实现 KV cache 内存近零浪费，以及请求内和跨请求的 KV cache 灵活共享。
评测显示 vLLM 在相同延迟水平下将主流 LLM 吞吐提升 2-4x，对比对象为 FasterTransformer 和 Orca。
论文指出该提升在更长序列、更大模型和更复杂解码算法下更为显著。
论文作者包括 Woosuk Kwon、Zhuohan Li、Ying Sheng、Lianmin Zheng、Ion Stoica 等，代码发布于 github.com/vllm-project/vllm。
raw_excerpt: we propose PagedAttention, an attention algorithm inspired by the classical virtual memory and paging techniques in operating systems. On top of it, we build vLLM, an LLM serving system that achieves (1) near-zero waste in KV cache memory and (2) flexible sharing of KV cache within and across requests ... vLLM improves the throughput of popular LLMs by 2-4$\times$

key_points: 该分析覆盖 Hugging Face Hub 上下载量最高的 50 个实体，这 50 个实体占 Hub 总下载量的 80.22%。
在可获知模型规模的模型中（占 top 50 的 96.94%、占整个 Hub 的 77.76%），小模型下载量占绝对主导：92.48% 的下载来自参数少于 10 亿的模型，86.33% 来自少于 5 亿参数的模型，69.83% 来自少于 2 亿参数的模型，40.17% 来自少于 1 亿参数的模型。
按模态划分，模型下载主要集中于 NLP（58.1%），其次为 CV（21.2%）、音频（15.1%）、多模态（3.3%）、时间序列（1.7%）。
文本编码器（base 模型及其任务微调）占总下载量 45% 以上（占 NLP 模态的 77.5%），而解码器仅占 9.5%（模态的 16.5%），编码器-解码器占 3%（模态的 5%）。
英语占使用语言标签模型下载量的 79.46% 以上（若仅计有语言标签的模型则为 92.85%），法语以 17.48% 位居第二。
按贡献者类型，企业占下载量 63.2%（50 个实体中 20 个），大学占 20.7%（10 个），个人占 12.1%（16 个），非营利组织占 3.8%（4 个），混合实验室占 0.3%（1 个）。

title: Model Pulse — download history for every Hugging Face model
key_points: Model Pulse 追踪 Hugging Face Hub 上 1,640,282 个模型的每日下载量、点赞数与衍生家族（derivative families），数据自 2024 年 7 月起每日更新。

title: What 19 months of daily downloads say about the Hugging Face Hub (Model Pulse report)
key_points: Hub 每天服务约 1 亿次模型下载（2026 年 9 月约 1.03 亿次/日），一年前约为 6100 万次/日。
全部下载中 43% 流向衍生模型（derivatives），高于此前的 18%；仅量化（quantizations）一项就从 9% 升至 28%。

title: Hub documentation — Models Download Stats (Hugging Face)
key_points: Hugging Face 官方文档说明模型下载量的计数方法：Hub 使用一组 query files 进行下载计数，以避免对单个模型仓库的多文件下载重复计数。
默认情况下（未指定 library 时）Hub 使用 config.json 作为默认 query file；其他库可能检查 pytorch_model.bin 或 adapter_config.json 等文件。
GGUF 文件因自包含且不绑定单一库，全部计入下载量，在整仓库克隆场景下可能造成重复计数。
该文档仅说明计数方法学，未提供 Hub 模型总数或累计下载总量的汇总数字。
raw_excerpt: Counting the number of downloads for models is not a trivial task, as a single model repository might contain multiple files ... the Hub uses a set of query files that are employed for download counting. ... By default, when no library is specified, the Hub uses config.json as the default query file.

title: General-Purpose AI Code of Practice - Wikipedia
key_points: The General-Purpose AI Code of Practice (GPAI CoP) is a compliance tool released by the European Commission on 10 July 2025 to support compliance with the EU AI Act.
It provides operational guidance for providers of general-purpose AI models, particularly in relation to Articles 53 and 55 of the AI Act, which entered into application on 2 August 2025.
The Code is organised into three chapters: Transparency, Copyright, and Safety and Security.
Although non-binding, adherence means EU regulators will assume providers following the Code meet the corresponding legal requirements; adherence is voluntary but AI Act compliance is not.
Article 56 of the AI Act empowers the EU AI Office to develop a voluntary rulebook for how model providers meet obligations in Articles 53 and 55.

Under Articles 53 and 55, developers of GPAI models whose training compute exceeds 10^23 FLOPs and that are placed on the EU market must meet transparency obligations and put in place a policy for EU copyright law.

Models trained with more than 10^25 FLOPs are classified as presenting systemic risk and are subject to enhanced safety requirements; the Commission may also designate a model as systemic risk below that compute figure (Annex XIII criteria).
The Code underwent three earlier iterations in November 2024, December 2024, and March 2025 before the final version was published on 10 July 2025, more than two months later than initially planned.
The development was drawn up by 13 independent experts across four thematic working groups, coordinated by the EU AI Office, drawing on contributions from nearly 1,000 stakeholders.

Signatories among U.S. companies include Amazon, Anthropic, Google, IBM, Microsoft, and OpenAI; xAI signed only the safety and security chapter; European signatories include Aleph Alpha and Mistral AI.
As of January 2026, Meta is the most notable company that has declined to sign the Code; major Chinese AI companies such as Alibaba, Baidu or DeepSeek have also not signed.

title: GPAI Code of Practice · Final Version · 10 July 2025 (Code of Practice Explorer, Future of Life Institute)
key_points: The General-Purpose AI Code of Practice is a voluntary framework developed under Article 56 of the EU AI Act.
It sets out practical measures that providers of general-purpose AI (GPAI) models — including frontier models — can adopt to demonstrate compliance with their obligations under the AI Act.
It is primarily relevant for GPAI model providers, downstream deployers, regulators, and civil society observers.

The Code has three chapters: Chapter 1 Transparency (documentation obligations for GPAI model providers — what to disclose, to whom, and how); Chapter 2 Copyright (copyright policy requirements, rights reservations, and transparency around training data); Chapter 3 Safety & Security (systemic risk assessment, safety frameworks, security mitigations, and incident reporting — for systemic-risk GPAI models).
The Code of Practice is officially published in English only; the site's other language versions are AI-generated translations.
The final version is dated 10 July 2025.

title: EU publishes final General-Purpose AI Code of Practice (PPC Land)
key_points: The European Commission officially received the finalized General-Purpose AI Code of Practice on July 10, 2025, according to documents published by the AI Office.
The framework establishes voluntary guidelines for AI model providers ahead of mandatory compliance requirements taking effect August 2, 2025.
The three-chapter code addresses transparency, copyright, and safety obligations under Articles 53 and 55 of the AI Act.
The Safety and Security chapter applies specifically to GPAI models with systemic risk — those exceeding 10^25 FLOP during training or designated by the Commission based on reach and capabilities.
The framework applies to providers placing general-purpose AI models on the EU market, regardless of provider location.
The transparency chapter establishes comprehensive documentation requirements for all general-purpose AI model providers.

Providers must maintain detailed records of training data provenance, computational resources, and energy consumption; energy reporting requires measurements recorded with at least two significant figures in megawatt-hours.

Security requirements include protection against insider threats and implementation of confidential computing using hardware-based trusted execution environments, plus multi-factor authentication for personnel accessing model weights.

title: Whack-a-Chip: The Futility of Hardware-Centric Export Controls
key_points: 论文摘要称这是「首个公开的具体证据」，展示中国领先 AI 实验室如何规避和绕过美国出口管制。
论文指出中国公司（尤以腾讯为例）不仅在使用受美国出口管制限制的芯片，还通过软件与建模技术最大化利用性能较弱的硬件来规避管制。
论文具体主张：腾讯用非出口管制的 NVIDIA H20 训练其 Hunyuan-Large 模型，说明机器学习效率提升已侵蚀美国出口管制最初建立的护城河。
论文正文提出两点核心论断：(1) 中国主要 AI 公司尽管面临出口管制，仍能获取高端受管制芯片；(2) 中国 AI 实验室利用 ML 训练工具进步，在较低质量、非出口管制的芯片（含 NVIDIA H20）上成功训练出 SOTA 模型。
论文认为基于硬件阈值的出口策略可以通过更好的软件被克服，并强调跟踪机器学习与算力效率前沿对预测竞争对手能力增长的重要性。
论文作者来自 UC Berkeley 的 Berkeley Risk and Security Lab 与 Berkeley AI Research Lab，发表于 AI Frontiers Initiative。
raw_excerpt: We examine how Chinese companies, notably Tencent, are not only using chips that are restricted under U.S. export controls but are also finding ways to circumvent these regulations by using software and modeling techniques that maximize less capable hardware. Specifically, we argue that Tencent's ability to power its Hunyuan-Large model with non-export controlled NVIDIA H20s exemplifies broader gains in efficiency in machine learning that have eroded the moat that the United States initially built via its existing export controls.

title: H20 Back in the Chinese Market: Washington's Calculated Adjustment (ECIPE)
key_points: NVIDIA 于 7 月 15 日宣布华盛顿决定，H20 GPU 恢复对华销售；AMD 的 MI308 出口许可申请也在审查中等待最终批准。
H20 是 NVIDIA H100 的刻意降规版本，为应对美国出口规则而设计，基于 2022 年的 Hopper 架构，算力仅为 H100 的一小部分。
2023 年 BIS 规则设定了严格的「性能密度（performance density, PD）」阈值，以算力与芯片面积之比为公式；H20 低于该限值，可绕过完整的商务部许可流程对华销售。
NVIDIA 此前已有「中国特供」产品先例：2024 年的 H800 与更早的 A800 都是 H100、A100 的定制降规版本，专为符合华盛顿规则而造。
自 2023 年 10 月 BIS 规则以来，H20 曾是唯一被设计为可合法进入中国市场的 AI 加速器，随后在中美贸易摩擦加剧下受到出口禁令，直至 2025 年 7 月中旬解禁。
2025 年 4 月的半导体规则导致 H20 与 MI308 对华出口「瘫痪数月」（months of paralysis）。
7 月中旬的放松不限于 AI 加速器，还包括放宽对华出口电子设计自动化（EDA）工具的管制。
文章认为华盛顿愿意以有限准入换取谈判筹码，同时维持刻意降规以放缓中国步伐。
raw_excerpt: While the H20 had been the only AI accelerator designed to legally enter the Chinese market since the BIS rules in October 2023, it soon became subject to export bans amid intensifying US-China trade frictions until recently being lifted in mid-July. The same applies to AMD's MI308, with the company confirming its export license application is under review and awaiting for final approval after months of paralysis under the April semiconductor rules.
